title: Android 10 with Pixel 3XL
symptom: After upgrading to Android 10 on Pixel 3XL, no successful sensor sessions. Transmitter shows connected in xDrip+ but not under phone Bluetooth settings. Sensor start fails or says 'sensor stopped'.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. Possible factors discussed include outdated xDrip version, transmitter/sensor session mismatch, Bluetooth name with space, and Trust Auto-Connect setting, but none confirmed.
fix: No definitive fix was confirmed. Suggested actions included updating to latest nightly/alpha, stopping and starting sensor, removing space from Bluetooth name, and disabling Trust Auto-Connect, but user reported no success.
evidence_quote: I've updated to the latest. It's still telling me that the sensor is stopped but it's still connecting to it.
